# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 3: Condottieri Contracts, Free Company Mutiny Disaster & Gunpowder Logistics Reform (oe_mer2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_mercenaries.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Charter Historical Condottieri Contract (5 regional flavors; builds +20 arrears risk)
oe_mer2_charter_condottieri_contract = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_MILITARY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = no
	use_in_automation = no
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 24

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		at_war = yes
		gold >= 220
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_standing_army_reformed }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 120
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_mer2_charter_condottieri_cd
		years = 5
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_military }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			exists = capital
			scope:actor = {
				has_discovered = prev.capital
				within_diplomatic_range = prev
			}
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			opinion = { target = scope:actor value >= -25 }
		}
	}

	diplo_chance = {
		base = 25
		opinion = 0.25
	}

	accept = {
		add = {
			desc = "oe_mer2_accept_charter_fee_tt"
			value = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = { is_enemy_of = scope:actor }
			}
			subtract = {
				desc = "oe_mer2_accept_hostile_tt"
				value = 50
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				transfer_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -2.5 min = 100 max = 600 target = scope:recipient }
				oe_mer2_apply_regional_charter = { PATRON = scope:recipient }
				custom_tooltip = oe_mer2_arrears_risk_plus_20_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					oe_mer2_add_arrears_risk = { AMOUNT = 20 }
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:actor
					modifier = oe_mer2_b_charter_patron
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -40
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					at_war = yes
					gold >= 250
					oe_mer2_risk_at_most_20 = yes
					NOT = { oe_mer2_has_any_charter = yes }
				}
			}
			add = 65
		}
	}
}

# 2. Subvert Enemy Mercenary Companies (covert wartime bribery; fires oe_mer2.6 on target)
oe_mer2_poach_enemy_mercenaries = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_COVERT_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = no
	use_in_automation = no
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		at_war = yes
		gold >= 250
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			at_war = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 150
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_mer2_poach_mercs_cd
		years = 5
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_covert }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_at_war_with = scope:actor
		}
		enabled = {
			scope:actor = {
				spy_network = { target = prev value >= 30 }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_mer2_target_has_mercs_tt
				oe_mer2_has_hired_or_chartered_mercs = yes
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_spy_network = { target = scope:recipient value = -30 }
				change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -4.0 min = 150 max = 1200 }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_mer2_mercenary_desertion
					years = 2
					mode = replace
				}
				custom_tooltip = oe_mer2_target_arrears_plus_18_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					oe_mer2_add_arrears_risk = { AMOUNT = 18 }
				}
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:actor
					modifier = oe_mer2_b_poached_mercs
				}
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mer2.6
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -50
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					gold >= 300
					spy_network = { target = scope:recipient value >= 35 }
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					oe_mer2_has_hired_or_chartered_mercs = yes
				}
			}
			add = 85
		}
	}
}

# 3. Subsidize Foreign Free Company (proxy war financing; transfers gold + leaves +10 arrears risk on recipient)
oe_mer2_subsidize_free_company = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_MILITARY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = no
	use_in_automation = no
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 24

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		gold >= 350
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 150
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_mer2_subsidize_merc_cd
		years = 6
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_military }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			at_war = yes
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			exists = capital
			scope:actor = {
				has_discovered = prev.capital
				within_diplomatic_range = prev
			}
		}
		enabled = {
			opinion = { target = scope:actor value >= -25 }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_foreign_merc_subsidy }
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_mer2_fighting_third_party_tt
				any_country_at_war_with = {
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				transfer_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -3.0 min = 150 max = 900 target = scope:recipient }
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_mer2_proxy_sponsor_influence
					years = 3
					mode = replace
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_mer2_foreign_merc_subsidy
					years = 3
					mode = replace
				}
				custom_tooltip = oe_mer2_target_arrears_plus_10_tt
				hidden_effect = {
					oe_mer2_add_arrears_risk = { AMOUNT = 10 }
				}
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:actor
					modifier = oe_mer2_b_subsidized_war
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -50
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = { gold >= 450 }
				scope:recipient = {
					any_country_at_war_with = {
						OR = {
							is_rival_of = scope:actor
							is_enemy_of = scope:actor
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 80
		}
	}
}
